title: Bounded tensor acyclicity from the homology factors
statement: Let $C$ be a small site with topology $T$ and let $R$ be a commutative ring sheaf. Let $P,K$ be cochain complexes of $R$-module sheaves [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Suppose $P$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], all its terms are flat, and there are integers $a,z$ such that $K^i=0$ whenever $i<a$ or $z<i$. If $\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R H^i(K)[0])$ is acyclic for every integer $i$, then $\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R K)$ is acyclic. There is no bound on $P$.

source.place: Tag 08J5, remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YM and 06YU, derived tensor exactness and definition.

proof.text: Use the fixed K-flat tensor descent and its resolving comparison to obtain an exact functor F on the standard derived category whose value on Q(L) computes the naive total P tensor L. The assumed termwise flatness and K-flatness are exactly its resolving hypotheses.

Apply the finite ordered Postnikov tower to Q(K), with lower bound a and length max(z-a,0)+1. The standard cohomology-factor comparison identifies each factor with H^i(K)[0] shifted by minus i. The hypotheses and the computation comparison kill the unshifted homology objects; commutation with shifts kills every factor. Applying F to each distinguished triangle shows inductively that every vertex is zero. Transfer the final zero vertex back through the computation comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_acyclic_of_bounded_homology
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {T : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf T CommRingCat.{u}) (P K : ringedSiteComplex R)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (P.X i))
    (hbounded : ∃ a z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ z < i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (hH : ∀ i : ℤ, (((ringedKoszulTensor R).obj P).obj
      ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj (K.homology i))).Acyclic) :
    (((ringedKoszulTensor R).obj P).obj K).Acyclic
